decisions.reason: The two-component glass flake spraying system extends the firm's core spraying and two-component know-how, so it can interpret field results and refine the system through its own R&D.

The low-pressure injection pump sits very close to the established injection and construction-repair offer, has its own web page, and fits existing knowledge and customers, so absorptive capacity for improving it is high.

The multi-model material transfer pump line builds directly on the firm's conveying and pump engineering, and the several models allow it to learn which variants perform and adjust within the line rather than drop it.

Fire protection flow monitoring moves somewhat toward sensing and digital monitoring, which is less familiar territory, but it supports the firm's digitalization goal and benefits from university cooperation, so the firm keeps it while it learns.
